# P36.37 — Map app shell (row 378, K1 MAP-03a)

The `/map/` T2 app shell over the P36.36 no-JS baseline: the island migrated
to **Preact**, MapLibre ships as the K1 ESM split, and the full app
(panel · list · selection · filters · state · legend · fallback) lands.

## Requirements

SIG-UI-065, SIG-UI-095, SIG-UI-097, SIG-UI-101, SIG-UI-102, SIG-UI-103,
SIG-UI-104, SIG-UI-106, SIG-UI-107 · cited SIG-UI-039/040/063, UXR-13,
UXR-18/SIG-UI-068, ADR-155/134, SIG-ENG-042.

## What changes

- `MapIsland.tsx` → Preact (`client:only="preact"`); `@astrojs/preact` +
  `preact` pinned; React scoped to the legacy islands. No react reaches the
  `/map/` bundle.
- `scripts/prepare-map-vendor.mjs` emits the MapLibre ESM split under
  `web/public/map/vendor/`; the app imports the entry and pins the worker —
  shared chunk fetched once.
- Overlay sources+layers merge INTO every basemap style document — the
  K1 §2.6 `basemap → context → plain` fallback keeps the record layers and
  shows the loud notice.
- App: tabs (In view/Filters/Selected), synced in-view list (places <z10,
  ≤50 records ≥z10), full SIG-UI-101 selection panel with resolvable-only
  links (UXR-18), facet counts + cannot-apply greys (SIG-UI-104), one-hue
  legend + status channels (SIG-UI-065/107), keyboard contract
  (SIG-UI-095), `sig.workspace-state/2` state round-trips (SIG-UI-103).
- `gen-map-styles.mjs` repairs: `namedFlavor()` (null colours), `protomaps`
  → `basemap` source id, non-string `text-font` → committed stack —
  regenerated styles.
- `page-budgets.json`: `jsInitialBytes` + `totalInitialMaxBytes` gaps
  remain over the ratified ceilings under the real wire measure
  (482,469 / 578,041 gz) — rows restored with bounded `regression_bound`s;
  `tbtMs` stays (CI-measured).
- `runtime-deps.json` + `check:runtime-deps` allow-list gate; `check-licenses`
  `caniuse-lite` named waiver.

## Verify

`astro check` 0 · vitest · build · `check:runtime-deps` ok · playwright
`islands` + `map-app` green · wire measure 482,469 B gz JS / 578,041 B
total (bounded gap rows) · all `check:*` gates green · `make check` + web
check via the head-bound CI leg (local env reds only).
